_curated_comment: generator/curated/aircraft_draft.json is a DRAFT for AJ's review; nothing reads it while curated_aircraft_enabled is false.

subtlety._comment: Types whose giveaway is fine texture (dots, rows, faint markings) rather than shape. add: extra difficulty points (0-100 scale); min_tier: never rated below this; visibility ignores texture for these types. A small, sparse or tree-covered one can still reach hard through the size and low-contrast terms. Types the generator doesn't produce yet (orchard, allotments, plaza) are listed so they're covered if added; unknown types are ignored.

cemetery.why: headstone dots in a lawn or clearing; looks like a park or field until you spot the rows

allotments.why: community garden plots look like any yard or field

plaza.why: paved square vs. a parking lot; only paving pattern and benches tell them apart
